description:
HIGH SPEED. HIGHER PURPOSE.

Join MPIRIQ as a Frontend Engineer.

100% Remote / Hybrid / Presence

About MPIRIQ

MPIRIQ connects real-world care and research to accelerate medical innovation. Our AI-driven platform structures and protects patient data at the source, helping doctors save time, researchers move faster, and patients benefit sooner.

We believe that Time is Health – and we design technology that gives it back to those who save lives.

The Role

We are looking for a Frontend Engineer (f/m/d) who brings complex systems to life with clarity and purpose. Working closely with our design and backend teams, you will shape how healthcare professionals interact with AI-powered tools that turn everyday care into progress.

What You’ll Do

  • build modern, responsive web applications that feel effortless and fast

  • translate UX and design concepts from Figma into clean, maintainable code

  • integrate frontend components with backend APIs and data pipelines

  • ensure top-notch accessibility, security, and performance across devices

  • collaborate with designers and backend engineers to refine product workflows

  • continuously improve our component library and internal development standards


What You Bring

  • at least 2 years work experience

  • strong experience with React, TypeScript, and modern web architectures

  • familiarity with design systems, component-based development, and responsive UI

  • understanding of API integration, authentication flows, and state management

  • knowledge of performance optimization and frontend testing

  • collaborative mindset and a sense for clean, intuitive design

  • fluency in English, good German skills are a plus

  • experience in medtech area

  • Vitest, Storybook or any other FE-testing tool


Why MPIRIQ

  • Purpose: Shape interfaces that make healthcare smarter and more human.

  • Ownership: You’ll have a direct impact on core products used by doctors and researchers.

  • Culture: Caring, clear, confident – we move fast, but with precision.

  • Growth: Be part of a small, skilled team building the foundation for large-scale impact.

organization.description: Accessus is a reliable and innovative company that facilitates clinical research partnerships, enabling practices to conduct studies without disrupting their operations. They provide access to cutting-edge therapies for patients in familiar settings, enhancing the quality of care in Germany. By optimizing existing research centers and supporting new ones, Accessus aims to improve patient outcomes and contribute to the advancement of medical research. Their model allows practices to participate in economically viable research while maintaining high standards of patient care, positioning them as a key player in the healthcare research landscape.
